latest.title: #34 Growing the Future: Young Voices in Biodynamic Farming
latest.description:
In this episode of the Living Farms Podcast, we meet three inspiring young biodynamic farmers from around the world: Putri Mirayanti from Bali, Rafael Anguita from Chile, and Sudarshan Chaudhary from Nepal.
They share how biodynamic farming is taking root in their local communities, combining regenerative agricultural practices with cultural traditions, education, and community engagement. From biodynamic beekeeping and community markets to training young farmers and strengthening local food systems, each guest offers a unique perspective on the opportunities and challenges of farming sustainably. Hear why the next generation of biodynamic farmers is playing a vital role in shaping the future of agriculture.

latest.title: #33 Transforming Farms with Holistic Design
latest.description:
What does it take to design farms that are not only productive but also resilient, regenerative, and deeply connected to the landscapes they inhabit?


In this episode, we’re joined by the Australien Darren Doherty, internationally renowned farm designer, educator, and pioneer in regenerative agriculture. Drawing on decades of experience across diverse climates and farming systems, Darren shares why successful farm design begins with understanding the whole system—not just its individual parts.


We explore the principles of holistic farm design, the critical role of project planning, and why management decisions often have a greater impact than infrastructure itself. Darren also discusses how traditional land stewardship can be combined with modern technologies to create practical, adaptable solutions for today's agricultural challenges.


From water management and landscape resilience to designing for different scales and environments, this conversation offers valuable insights for farmers, land stewards, designers, and anyone interested in building healthier ecosystems.

What is the nature of this rebirth, how is it related to the great developmental crises and processes taking place within humanity in our time, and what are the next seven years asking those of us who would place ourselves in the service of this renewal?

Robert Karp (aka Karbelnikoff) has been a student of anthroposophy, esoteric Christianity and social threefolding for over forty years. For many decades, he has been a leader in the biodynamic, organic and local food movements, pioneering impact investing in organic farmland and starting numerous local and regional food system projects. Robert has a master’s degree in educational leadership, a certificate in anthroposophical psychology and is increasingly focused on teaching workshops on esoteric christianity, social threefolding, goethean movement, and earth healing. In diesem Vortrag wird es um eine vertiefte Betrachtung von Rudolf Steiners sechs Nebenübungen gehen. Wenn wir diese Übungen vom Gesichtspunkt der Schwelle betrachten, wachen wir auf für ihren tieferen Sinn, der unmittelbar zu unserem Schicksalsfeld führt. latest.title: Bernd Ruf: Emergency Pedagogy, Trauma, and Resilience | Wilton 2026
latest.description:
In a world shaped by collective trauma, school violence, and ongoing crises, what does it take to work with the most wounded among us without becoming wounded ourselves?                                                                  

Bernd Ruf, founder of the Parsifal Center in Karlsruhe and a pioneer of Waldorf emergency pedagogy, introduces the themes of Modules 5 and 11 of the Emergency Pedagogy training: severe targeted violence, the psychology of perpetrators, resilience research (Maslow, Antonovsky, Werner, Tedeschi), and the psycho-hygienic inner work that protects practitioners from secondary traumatization.

  He invites you to join him at the Center for Anthroposophy's Summer Weeks in Wilton, New Hampshire, in July 2026, where Modules 5 and 11 will be taught in person.
                                                                                                                          
Topics covered:
  • The rise of collective traumatization and why emergency pedagogy is more relevant than ever
  • What drives children to commit acts of targeted violence (Columbine, recent events)                                   
• Peter Langman's four-type perpetrator profile                                                                         • Trauma as a "contagious" condition and the need for psycho-hygienic protection                                        
• Resilience: individual factors, social networks, and a spiritual understanding of the human being                     
• How anthroposophy contributes to emergency pedagogical training

latest.description:

Hier hält der Leider der Landbauschule des biodynamischen Dottenfelderhof in Bad Vilbel, Martin von Mackensen, einen spannenden Vortrag über die Möglichkeiten in Verwurzelung Stärkung und (Ver-)bindung zu finden. Der Vortrag fand am 16. Oktober 2026 im Rahmen der Tagung "bildungsART 26" statt. Das Motto der diesjährigen Veranstaltung war "Aus Uns Schöpfen". 

Zitat:

"Und da sind für mich drei Dinge aufgetaucht, die ich nehme aus diesem wunderbaren kleinen Vortrag, aus diesem Vortrag Praktische Ausbildung des Denkens, Rudolf Steiner, 1909, die Zaubermittel, drei ganz einfache Zaubermittel. Interesse, Lust und Liebe und Besinnung […] Und Interesse ist auch die Frage, kann ich mich so fokussieren, kann ich dann so drinnen sein, dass in mir das Andere wirkt. Also kann ich Interesse so weit treiben, dass ich wirklich in dem bin, was mir gegenüber ist […] Lust und Liebe. Ich liebe den Steiner dafür, dass er das so dahin knallt. In allem Handeln, in allem, was ich tue, so verbunden sein, dass es nicht nur Spaß macht oder nicht nur irgendwie ganz locker von der Hand geht, sondern dass man aus dem Verbundensein, aus dem Interessiertsein eine Lust an der Handlung hat. Dass Handeln die tiefste Befriedigung ist, die man eigentlich haben kann. Dass das wirklich etwas ist wie Lust. Die Lust am Handeln, die Lust am Vollziehen, die Lust am Tun, die Lust am Drinnensein. […] Und das Dritte […] besinnen […] Habe ich die innere Ruhe, habe ich die innere Fähigkeit, einen Moment Verwurzelung nach innen, Verwurzelung in das, was das trägt. Nicht da drinnen, sondern in dem, was das hervorgebracht hat, in dem, womit ich da verbunden bin."

Was meinen wir eigentlich, wenn wir von Liebe reden?

"(...) Der Okkultismus sagt: Die Liebe ist für die Welt dasjenige, was die Sonne für das äußere Leben ist. Es würden keine Seelen mehr gedeihen können, wenn die Liebe weg wäre von der Welt. Die Liebe ist die moralische Sonne der Welt. Wäre es für einen Menschen, der Wohlgefallen, Interesse hat an dem Blumenwachstum einer Wiese, nicht absurd, wenn er wünschen würde, daß die Sonne verschwinde aus der Welt? Ins Moralische übertragen heißt das: Man muß Interesse haben daran, daß eine gesunde Entwickelung sich durchringt in den Menschheitszusammenhängen. Weise ist es, wenn wir so viel Liebe wie möglich über die Erde ausgestreut haben. Einzig weise ist es, wenn wir die Liebe fördern auf der Erde. (...)" Rudolf Steiner, Zürich, 17.12.1912

Dieser Vortrag stammt aus dem Jahr 1912, zu einer Zeit, da Rudolf Steiner noch innerhalb der Theosophischen Bewegung tätig war. Grade aus dem Inhalt dieses Vortrages kann man ersehen, welche Motive seiner Trennung von der Theosophischen Bewegung und der Begründung der Anthroposophischen Bewegung zu Grunde lagen.

La pensée scientifique à l'époque révolue de Gabriel. Éveil d'une compréhension du spirituel à l'époque naissante de Michael. La descente du Christ sur terre pour passer par la mort. L'élévation de Michael d'envoyé de Jahvé à l'envoyé du Christ, d'Esprit du Peuple à l'Esprit du Temps.

Parmi les points abordés :

Quel être est Michael ? L'intelligence abstraite est occupée de nom, rien que de nom, et s'imagine tenir quelque chose lorsque d'aventure elle s’est posée cette question et veut savoir : Il est sorti de telle hiérarchie ou de telle autre. C'est un archange. Les archanges ont telle ou telle qualité. Puis on passe aux définitions et on croit alors savoir ce qu'est un tel être.

Mais il ne suffit pas d'évoquer le nom de Michael, parce que dès l'instant où on veut comprendre l'évolution de l'humanité, il faut comprendre Michael dans son évolution, comprendre que c'est la même entité qui a donné le ton pour préparer le mystère du Golgotha et qui maintenant, à notre époque, donne le ton pour comprendre le mystère du Golgotha.

L'image de Michael vainqueur du dragon a aujourd'hui une autre signification que celle qu'elle avait pour les époques précédentes.

L'époque révolue de Gabriel. L'époque de Michael depuis le dernier tiers du XIXe siècle. Accession de Michael à la hiérarchie des Archées, apport du monde spirituel au monde sensible. L'impulsion de Michael et la vision anthroposophique du monde.

Parmi les points abordés :

À l'avenir, les êtres humains qui se distingueront par une personnalité au caractère nettement marqué, devront ce caractère distinctif de leur personnalité au fait qu'ils s'appuieront, pour parler de ceci ou de cela, sur la compréhension des mondes suprasensibles. Les Alexandre, les César, les Napoléon appartiennent au passé. Sans doute furent-ils baignés d'éléments suprasensibles, mais leur personnalité haute en couleur est due à ce qu'ils ont reçu « d'en bas », de leur corporéité. Les êtres humains qui sont des personnalités par la manière dont ils apportent le monde spirituel dans le sensible, les êtres humains qui puisent dans leur âme la personnalité qu'ils apportent dans l'humanité, ces hommes-là seront les personnalités qui prendront la relève des Alexandre, des César, des Napoléon. La force des actions humaines à l'avenir dépendra de la force avec laquelle l'impact spirituel viendra s'y déverser.

Nous vivons le passage d'une époque à l'autre et ce qui en l'occurrence donne à ce passage son caractère le plus significatif, c'est qu'au stade de développement où nous en sommes, on passe de l'époque de Gabriel à l'époque de Michael.

latest.title: Искусство становящегося сообщества. Райнер Шнурре
latest.description:
Запись лекции состоялась 30 января 2019.
Москва, вальдорфская школа им. Пинского.
Переводчик Оксана Каплина.

Райнер Шнурре - антропософ из Германии, основатель направления "Художественная биографическая работа", "Искусство становящегося сообщества". На протяжении последних 5 лет Райнер приезжал из Германии и много времени проводил в России: вел образование, различные курсы и семинары, индивидуальные консультации. 

Райнер разработал художественную биографическую работу, построенную на феноменологическом подходе; всю жизнь занимался самовоспитанием и Socialkunstgeschaltung (Искусством становящегося сообщества). Много лет Райнер посвятил работе с зависимостями. Райнер Шнурре, как кинорежиссер, писатель и социальный художник, активно выступал за триединство социального организма. Для него была особенно важна встреча человека с человеком.

В 2021 году снял фильм «Накануне шторма» о социальной трехчленности (переведён на русский язык). Обучал динамическому рисованию знаков Зодиака по Вольфгангу Вегенеру, был его последним учеником. 

Последние 5 лет интенсивно работал в России с группами и возлагал большие надежды на Россию: «Только вы, русские, способны одушевить антропософию», говорил он в последнее время.
11 ноября 2023 года, через 14 дней после своего 78-летия, Райнер Шнурре перешёл Порог Духовного мира.

В России у него остались ученики, продолжающие и развивающие импульсы работы с духовным исследованием, биографией человека и с социальными вопросами. Каждый год в России проходят группы по динамическому рисованию Зодиака, художественной биографической работе и социальному вопросу. Переведены и выпущены на русский язык его книги и практические пособия по Художественной биографической работе, динамическому рисованию Зодиака, социальному искусству. В 2022 году вышла на русский язык его знаковая книга «Кармическое сообщество».

In this second lecture of our series, we see how Rudolf Steiner introduced three new major elements into the instructions given to the first eurythmy students. 
First, he introduced the laws of syntax, or grammar, and showed how the structural laws of thinking, which are fundamental to sentence building and to expressing thoughts, can be made visible in eurythmy. Specific forms were shown for nouns (differentiating concrete and abstract noouns; verbs (contrasting active, passive, and duration); prepositions, adjectives, articles, and more.
Next, he introduced forms that have a "cosmic" dynamic, thereby beginning to a foundation for the fundamentals of relating eurythmy to the macrcosm. He also showed specific gestures for each of the different planets and their corresponding vowels, and to each of the signs of the zodiac and their corresponding consonants.
Finally, he began to show the first elements of how to present musical elements in eurythmy. although this was a very primitive beginning for what later began to flourish.

latest.description:
In questo video vi mostriamo il gesto euritmico della consonante D, così come è stato indicato da Rudolf Steiner.

«Immaginate un bellissimo e pacifico paesaggio serale. Non grandioso, ma fatto di morbide e dolci catene collinari. Sullo sfondo il sole sta tramontando proprio tra due colline. Alcune nuvole bianche stanno ferme, immobili nel cielo, e guardano dall'alto una ridente valle prativa. Un piccolo ruscello scorre mormorando piano come un sogno, alberi e arbusti si trovano lungo la sua riva e si specchiano nelle sue acque tranquille, i fiori sbocciano nel prato e sui pendii delle colline ci sono alberi da frutto carichi di frutti che stanno maturando. Forse là in lontananza, su uno dei pendii, lavora ancora un uomo, silenzioso e calmo, avvolto in questa pace serale. La natura riposa interamente racchiusa in se stessa.

E voi camminate attraverso questa valle, abbandonati e accolti in questa atmosfera serena, e con ogni cosa – che sia un albero, il sole, le nuvole nel cielo, i fiori e gli arbusti del prato, il ruscello al vostro fianco, l'uomo là in lontananza, i frutti degli alberi – con tutto vi sentite uno e connessi, e salutate ognuna di esse con questo movimento.»

Poi fece un movimento della mano indicibilmente dolce, che si abbassava piano con il palmo rivolto verso il basso, più volte di seguito, sollevando ogni volta la mano che si rilassava verso l'alto e poi di nuovo, abbassandola verso il basso, con le dita più distese che tese fino alla punta. Era come una foglia che si era staccata dal suo ramo e, come portata dall'aria, si posava dolcemente a terra. «Questa è una D».

latest.description:
¡Bienvenido a la finca bananera Granja Fátima en Santa Marta, Colombia!
Una hermosa experiencia de un "bosque de plátanos".
Visite esta granja biodinámica y certificada por Demeter en Colombia y siga a los agricultores Victoria y Louis que nos guían por ella. 
"Esto es una unidad. La granja Granja no es sólo lo que implican sus certificaciones, sino lo que es como unidad. Una granja como una granja: Nuestra Granja Fátima es preciosa. Vas caminando y te das cuenta de que estás en otro lugar. No es que te lo cuente, te invito a recorrerla. " - Victoria Bernier

Los plátanos son saludables, eso es bien sabido: la fruta perfecta y una fuente de vitaminas, minerales y fibra. Se consideran un alimento completo y son populares entre jóvenes y mayores.
Pero los plátanos también son una fruta problemática, precisamente por su popularidad. La demanda mundial conduce a un monocultivo, optimizado para la masa, que puede destruir ecosistemas enteros. Esto va acompañado de un uso masivo de productos químicos: la industria del plátano es un sector con un alto consumo de pesticidas. Esto tiene consecuencias devastadoras para el suelo, las aguas subterráneas y la biodiversidad. Sobre todo, para la salud de los trabajadores de las plantaciones, que a veces están expuestos a los productos químicos altamente tóxicos sin protección.
Los plátanos Demeter son diferentes de todos los demás plátanos del mercado, porque representan más de lo que puede ofrecer la palabra "ecológico". Se cultivan de acuerdo con las normas ecológicas más estrictas. No están optimizados para maximizar los beneficios y se cultivan sistemáticamente sin pesticidas ni contaminantes artificiales. Además, son el producto de los valores de los productores Demeter que piensan y actúan con amor, fuerza, alegría y libertad. Demeter practica una agricultura holística.

latest.title: L'école à 3 ans en Waldorf
latest.description:
À l'heure où la scolarisation des très jeunes enfants est de plus en plus encouragée, il est essentiel de rappeler une chose : les jeunes enfants apprennent sans cesse.
Mais ils n'apprennent pas d'abord en restant assis à une table.

Ils apprennent en imitant les adultes qui cuisinent, rangent ou jardinent. Ils apprennent en jouant librement, en grimpant, en construisant, en explorant la nature. Ils apprennent en écoutant des histoires, en chantant, en vivant au rythme de journées prévisibles et rassurantes.

Dans les jardins d'enfants Waldorf, ces expériences ne sont pas une pause dans les apprentissages : elles en sont le fondement. L'autonomie naît des gestes du quotidien. Le langage se nourrit des échanges et des récits. La motricité se construit dans le mouvement libre. L'attention, la créativité, la confiance en soi et les compétences sociales se développent à travers le jeu et la vie partagée.

Ces apprentissages informels, profondément adaptés aux besoins du jeune enfant, préparent les acquisitions plus formelles qui viendront plus tard. Avant d'apprendre à lire, écrire ou compter, l'enfant construit les bases qui lui permettront de le faire avec confiance et enthousiasme.

Parce que les racines précèdent les fleurs. 🌷

Camphill School Aberdeen is a charity (Registration No.SC015588) founded in 1940.  We were the first school for children with additional support needs in the UK and we founded the global Camphill Movement; one of the largest networks of independent charities in the world.  

Our work empowers over 100 local children and young people to grow in confidence, independence and reach their fullest potential by accessing our sector leading day and residential services. Our young people have learning disabilities and complex additional support needs, such as Autism Spectrum Disorder, Down’s Syndrome, Asperger’s Syndrome, Attachment Disorder and Foetal alcohol syndrome; as a minimum our young people require at least 1:1 specialist support.

Imagine falling from a 2.5 story balcony on your 20th birthday, causing you to spend 3 months of your life in a coma followed by years of therapy, social exclusion, and unemployment. Meet Ryan, one of Soltane Café’s valuable, kind, and hard working employees with intellectual differences. 

“Working here…it’s like therapy…and the social aspect has been extraordinarily helpful for me. Everyone is understanding and it’s a great place to work.” Biking to work each day, Ryan has become a special part of the Soltane Café team this year. He wanted to share his story here because what he needed more than anything was for someone to just give him a chance—to learn, to be a part of something, and to show what he can do.

Your investment in Camphill Soltane is an investment in the future for someone like Ryan! Adults with intellectual differences face endless lifelong barriers to accessible continuing education, fulfilling employment, creative development, and rich social inclusion. We cannot open the door to inclusive equal opportunities without gifts made by generous supporters like you!

Troubadours and Cathars of the Languedoc. Part 1: The Troubadours. by Carol Holmsen
latest.description:
Troubadours and Cathars of the Languedoc. Through glimpses from a study-tour to the Pyrenees and a Concert with Eurythmy. Part 1: The Troubadours by Carol Holmsen.

Zoom talk with PowerPoint about the Troubadours and Cathars of the medieval Languedoc with illustrations, pictures and musical clips. Facts and romanticized fiction. Why a presentation about the troubadours and the Cathars in a webinar series about Manichaeism? Who were the Troubadours and the Cathars? What was Courtly Love? Examples of several Troubadour songs. What were Cathar beliefs? Were they connected with Manichaeism? What was the Albigensian Crusade which led to the demise of the Cathars and the decline of the Troubadours? 

This presentation is seen through the “lens” of a Concert with Eurythmy of Troubadour Music with a section on their neighbors and contemporaries, the Cathars, as well as through glimpses from a study-tour to the Pyrenees with Roland van Vliet in 2015. The 1987 series of Concerts with Eurythmy about the Troubadours and Cathars in Languedoc in the 1200’s was held in Norway. In the first part of this presentation, an attempt will be made to take a deep dive through immersion into the poetry and music of the Troubadours and the framework of ideas behind them. In the second part of this presentation, the story of the Cathars, who they were, what they believed, how they lived and their tragic end will be presented. 

Carol Holmsen has worked in the teaching and health fields and has a background in eurythmy, curative eurythmy, nursing, rhythmical massage, homeopathy, English and literature. Author, translator, sheep-keeper of Old Norwegian short-tailed sheep, and a weaver.

latest.title: Manicheism and Rosicrucianism: Their Kinship in the Past, Present, and Future by Steve Roberts, UK
latest.description:
Rudolf Steiner consistently emphasized the future importance of the Manichean stream yet dedicated only one single lecture to the subject. He also stated that the Manichean stream would become more important than the Rosicrucian stream, creating a new form into which future Christianity would “pour”. Stephen will examine these claims in the light of Dutch anthroposophist Bernard Lievegoed’s final writings, and then look at indications given by Steiner to his young pupil Ehrenfried Pfeiffer of early historical links between two young men personally initiated by Christ, namely Lazarus of the John Gospel, who became Christian Rosenkreutz and the ‘Youth of Nain’ of the Luke Gospel who became Mani. Reference is also made to research done by Walter Johannes Stein, also a pupil of Steiner. 

Stephen Roberts (b. 1951 in New Zealand; resident in the U.K. since 1978) met anthroposophy in 1973 and has been involved with the work of Rudolf Steiner ever since – predominantly in curative education, book publishing, his own personal study, and writings/presentations. Steve has focused on the Grail, Knights Templar, Rosicrucianism and other Western Mystery traditions. On recovering from a critical health event in 2022, he was strongly drawn to both Manichaeism and Steiner’s cultic work, the Misraim-Dienst established in 1906 which has continued in an unbroken lineage to these times as the ‘Michael Service’ (Michael-Dienst). Stephen’s biography of English occultist Nevill Meakin (1876–1912), an early pupil of Rudolf Steiner and intimate friend of Edith Maryon, will be published by Holythorn Press (U.K.) in 2027.
